title: Splat Expressions
scenario: Splat expressions extract one attribute from every object in a list, and index syntax reads a single object. Build a list of names and the first instance's private IP.
constraints: Use var.instances[*].name for the name list.
Use var.instances[0].private_ip for the primary IP.
Keep both values in the locals block.

focus.title: Extract instance attributes
focus.todo: Use a splat for every name and index for the first IP.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `locals`. Use a splat for every name and index for the first IP. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `locals`. Use this code shape: instance_names; primary_ip. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.instances`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
